cond_0001.intro:
We are looking for a Research Assistant to join our team. This work is focused on participant recruitment, retention, data collection and cross-site communication to improve health outcomes in Native communities.
The Research Assistant will primarily assist in the day-to-day logistical and operational tasks for various research studies at the site. The Research Assistant will interact with the investigators, collaborators, and participants in a research environment. This person will assist in carrying out research in accordance with good clinical practices in such activities as obtaining informed consent, data and specimen collection, and patient follow-up over time.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Specific Duties & Responsibilities
Maintain a good working knowledge of all assigned protocols and reporting requirements. Run routine and ad hoc reports from databases. Adhere to all protocol requirements to ensure validity of clinical research data. Interact with clinicians and other stakeholders to access the participant population. Recruit research participants. Verify participant eligibility for studies. Interview participants. Schedule follow-up visits. Perform data collection. Enter data into a computer database. Generate and summarize data into reports to share with PIs and Study Physicians. Maintain paper and computerized research files. Assist with facilitation of site staff meetings. Prepare for and participate in audits and monitoring of studies. Assist in preparation of IRB protocols and related documents. Meet regularly with research staff and site manager to review data accuracy, enrollment reports, and overall study progress. Communicate study findings and updates to tribal leaders and community stakeholders. This description is a general statement of required duties and responsibilities performed on a regular and continuous basis; the Research Assistant will perform other related duties as assigned.

cond_0045.intro:
We are looking for a Research Assistant to join our team. This work is focused on participant recruitment, retention, data collection, and cross-site communication to improve health outcomes in Native communities.
The Research Assistant will work alongside investigators, collaborators, and participants in a research environment, helping to carry out research in accordance with good clinical practices. This includes supporting informed consent processes, data and specimen collection, and participant follow-up over time.
cond_0045.responsibilities:
Maintain a shared working knowledge of all assigned protocols and reporting requirements.
Run routine and ad hoc reports from databases.
Adhere to all protocol requirements to help ensure validity of clinical research data.
Coordinate with clinicians and other stakeholders to access the participant population.
Support recruitment of research participants.
Help verify participant eligibility for studies.
Interview participants.
Schedule follow-up visits.
Assist with data collection.
Enter data into a computer database.
Summarize and share data reports with PIs and Study Physicians.
Maintain paper and computerized research files.
Help facilitate site staff meetings.
Prepare for and participate in audits and monitoring of studies, working alongside the research team.
Assist in preparation of IRB protocols and related documents.
Meet regularly with research staff and site manager to review data accuracy, enrollment reports, and overall study progress.
Share study findings and updates with tribal leaders and community stakeholders.

The Research Assistant will work alongside investigators, collaborators, and participants across various research studies. Together, the team carries out research in accordance with good clinical practices, including obtaining informed consent, data and specimen collection, and participant follow-up over time.
cond_0108.responsibilities:
Maintain a shared working knowledge of all assigned protocols and reporting requirements.
Run routine and ad hoc reports from databases.
Adhere to all protocol requirements to help ensure validity of clinical research data.
Coordinate with clinicians and other stakeholders to access the participant population.
Support recruitment of research participants.
Verify participant eligibility for studies.
Interview participants.
Schedule follow-up visits.
Collect data in coordination with the research team.
Enter data into a computer database.
Generate and summarize data into reports to share with PIs and Study Physicians.
Maintain paper and computerized research files.
Help facilitate site staff meetings.
Prepare for and participate in audits and monitoring of studies alongside study staff.
Assist in preparation of IRB protocols and related documents.
Meet regularly with research staff and site manager to review data accuracy, enrollment reports, and overall study progress.
Share study findings and updates with tribal leaders and community stakeholders.
The Research Assistant will perform other related duties as assigned.

Proficiency in the use of computers, including software applications, databases, spreadsheets, and word processing.
Excellent organizational and time management skills.
Independent and self-motivated.
Highly organized and detail oriented.

Ability to communicate effectively across disciplines and within a variety of cultures.

The successful candidate(s) for this position will be subject to a pre-employment background check. A prior criminal history does not automatically preclude candidates from employment. In accordance with applicable law, the date of a candidate's conviction, the nature of the conviction, and how the conviction relates to an essential job-related qualification or function will be reviewed on an individual basis.
The pre-employment physical for positions in clinical areas, laboratories, working with research subjects, or involving community contact requires documentation of immune status against Rubella (German measles), Rubeola (Measles), Mumps, Varicella (chickenpox), Hepatitis B and documentation of having received the Tdap (Tetanus, diphtheria, pertussis) vaccination. This may include documentation of having two (2) MMR vaccines; two (2) Varicella vaccines; or antibody status to these diseases from laboratory testing. Blood tests for immunities to these diseases are ordinarily included in the pre-employment physical exam except for those employees who provide results of blood tests or immunization documentation from their own health care providers. Any vaccinations required for these diseases will be given at no cost in our Occupational Health office.

cond_0126.intro:
We are looking for a Research Assistant to join our team. This work is focused on participant recruitment, retention, data collection, and cross-site communication to help improve health outcomes in Native communities.
The Research Assistant will work alongside investigators, collaborators, and participants across various research studies. Together, the team carries out research in accordance with good clinical practices, including obtaining informed consent, data and specimen collection, and participant follow-up over time.
cond_0126.responsibilities:
Maintain a shared working knowledge of all assigned protocols and reporting requirements.
Run routine and ad hoc reports from databases.
Adhere to all protocol requirements to help ensure validity of clinical research data.
Coordinate with clinicians and other stakeholders to access the participant population.
Support recruitment of research participants.
Verify participant eligibility for studies.
Interview participants.
Schedule follow-up visits.
Collect data in coordination with the research team.
Enter data into a computer database.
Generate and summarize data into reports to share with PIs and Study Physicians.
Maintain paper and computerized research files.
Help facilitate site staff meetings.
Prepare for and participate in audits and monitoring of studies alongside study staff.
Assist in preparation of IRB protocols and related documents.
Meet regularly with research staff and site manager to review data accuracy, enrollment reports, and overall study progress.
Share study findings and updates with tribal leaders and community stakeholders.
The Research Assistant will perform other related duties as assigned.

Proficiency in the use of computers, including software applications, databases, spreadsheets, and word processing.
Excellent organizational and time management skills.
Independent and self-motivated.

Excellent oral and written communication skills.
Demonstrated strong, positive interpersonal skills.
Ability to communicate effectively across disciplines and within a variety of cultures.

The successful candidate(s) for this position will be subject to a pre-employment background check. A prior criminal history does not automatically preclude candidates from employment. In accordance with applicable law, the date of a candidate's conviction, the nature of the conviction, and how the conviction relates to an essential job-related qualification or function will be reviewed on an individual basis.
The pre-employment physical for positions in clinical areas, laboratories, working with research subjects, or involving community contact requires documentation of immune status against Rubella (German measles), Rubeola (Measles), Mumps, Varicella (chickenpox), Hepatitis B and documentation of having received the Tdap (Tetanus, diphtheria, pertussis) vaccination. This may include documentation of having two (2) MMR vaccines; two (2) Varicella vaccines; or antibody status to these diseases from laboratory testing. Blood tests for immunities to these diseases are ordinarily included in the pre-employment physical exam except for those employees who provide results of blood tests or immunization documentation from their own health care providers. Any vaccinations required for these diseases will be given at no cost in our Occupational Health office.

cond_0247.intro: We are looking for a Research Assistant to join our team at [Company name masked]. This work is focused on participant recruitment, retention, data collection and cross-site communication to improve health outcomes in Native communities. The Research Assistant will primarily assist in the day-to-day logistical and operational tasks for various research studies at the site, interacting with investigators, collaborators, and participants in a research environment. This person will assist in carrying out research in accordance with good clinical practices in such activities as obtaining informed consent, data and specimen collection, and patient follow-up over time. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the kind of public health research work and community engagement it involves.
cond_0247.responsibilities: Maintain a good working knowledge of all assigned protocols and reporting requirements. Run routine and ad hoc reports from databases. Adhere to all protocol requirements to ensure validity of clinical research data. Interact with clinicians and other stakeholders to access the participant population. Recruit research participants. Verify participant eligibility for studies. Interview participants. Schedule follow-up visits. Perform data collection. Enter data into a computer database. Generate and summarize data into reports to share with PIs and Study Physicians. Maintain paper and computerized research files. Assist with facilitation of site staff meetings. Prepare for and participate in audits and monitoring of studies. Assist in preparation of IRB protocols and related documents. Meet regularly with research staff and site manager to review data accuracy, enrollment reports, and overall study progress. Communicate study findings and updates to tribal leaders and community stakeholders. This description is a general statement of required duties and responsibilities performed on a regular and continuous basis; the Research Assistant will perform other related duties as assigned.
cond_0247.requirements:
Proficiency in the use of computers, including software applications, databases, spreadsheets, and word processing; excellent organizational and time management skills. Independent and self-motivated. Highly organized and detail oriented. Ability to manage multiple and competing priorities. Excellent oral and written communication skills. Demonstrated strong, positive interpersonal skills. Ability to communicate effectively across disciplines and within a variety of cultures. Native language speaker. Knowledge of the community geography, ability to locate participant homes and navigate rural roads effectively and safely. Current driver's license issued by the state of residence and good driving record required. Ability to travel with overnight stays required as needed. This may include documentation of having two (2) MMR vaccines; two (2) Varicella vaccines; or antibody status to these diseases from laboratory testing. Blood tests for immunities to these diseases are ordinarily included in the pre-employment physical exam except for those employees who provide results of blood tests or immunization documentation from their own health care providers. The Research Assistant will primarily assist in the day-to-day logistical and operational tasks for various research studies at the site. The Research Assistant will interact with the investigators, collaborators, and participants in a research environment. This person will assist in carrying out research in accordance with good clinical practices in such activities as obtaining informed consent, data and specimen collection, and patient follow-up over time.
cond_0271.responsibilities:
Specific Duties & Responsibilities
Maintain a good working knowledge of all assigned protocols and reporting requirements. Run routine and ad hoc reports from databases. Adhere to all protocol requirements to ensure validity of clinical research data. Interact with clinicians and other stakeholders to access the participant population. Recruit research participants. Verify participant eligibility for studies. Interview participants. Schedule follow-up visits. Perform data collection. Enter data into a computer database. Generate and summarize data into reports to share with PIs and Study Physicians. Maintain paper and computerized research files. Assist with facilitation of site staff meetings. Prepare for and participate in audits and monitoring of studies. Assist in preparation of IRB protocols and related documents. Meet regularly with research staff and site manager to review data accuracy, enrollment reports, and overall study progress. Communicate study findings and updates to tribal leaders and community stakeholders. This description is a general statement of required duties and responsibilities performed on a regular and continuous basis; the Research Assistant will perform other related duties as assigned.

cond_0477.intro:
We are looking for a Research Assistant to join our team. This work is focused on participant recruitment, retention, data collection, and cross-site communication to improve health outcomes in Native communities.
The Research Assistant will work alongside investigators, collaborators, and participants in a research environment, helping to carry out research in accordance with good clinical practices. This includes supporting informed consent processes, data and specimen collection, and participant follow-up over time.
cond_0477.responsibilities:
Maintain a shared working knowledge of all assigned protocols and reporting requirements.
Run routine and ad hoc reports from databases.
Adhere to all protocol requirements to help ensure validity of clinical research data.
Coordinate with clinicians and other stakeholders to access the participant population.
Support recruitment of research participants.
Help verify participant eligibility for studies.
Interview participants.
Schedule follow-up visits.
Assist with data collection.
Enter data into a computer database.
Summarize and share data reports with PIs and Study Physicians.
Maintain paper and computerized research files.
Help facilitate site staff meetings.
Prepare for and participate in audits and monitoring of studies, working alongside the research team.
Assist in preparation of IRB protocols and related documents.
Meet regularly with research staff and site manager to review data accuracy, enrollment reports, and overall study progress.
Share study findings and updates with tribal leaders and community stakeholders.

The Research Assistant will own the day-to-day logistical and operational tasks for various research studies at the site. You will engage directly with investigators, collaborators, and participants, and take responsibility for carrying out research in accordance with good clinical practices — including obtaining informed consent, collecting data and specimens, and managing patient follow-up over time.
cond_0485.responsibilities: Maintain a thorough working knowledge of all assigned protocols and reporting requirements. Run routine and ad hoc reports from databases. Ensure validity of clinical research data by adhering to all protocol requirements. Engage with clinicians and other stakeholders to access the participant population. Lead participant recruitment. Verify participant eligibility for studies. Conduct participant interviews. Schedule follow-up visits. Execute data collection. Enter data into a computer database. Generate and summarize data into reports to share with PIs and Study Physicians. Maintain paper and computerized research files. Drive facilitation of site staff meetings. Prepare for and lead participation in audits and monitoring of studies. Take ownership of preparation of IRB protocols and related documents. Meet regularly with research staff and site manager to review data accuracy, enrollment reports, and overall study progress. Deliver study findings and updates to tribal leaders and community stakeholders. The Research Assistant will perform other related duties as assigned.
cond_0485.requirements:
Proficiency in the use of computers, including software applications, databases, spreadsheets, and word processing. Excellent organizational and time management skills. Independent and self-motivated. Highly organized and detail oriented. Ability to manage multiple and competing priorities. Excellent oral and written communication skills. Demonstrated strong, positive interpersonal skills. Ability to communicate effectively across disciplines and within a variety of cultures. Native language speaker. Knowledge of the community geography, ability to locate participant homes and navigate rural roads effectively and safely. Current driver's license issued by the state of residence and good driving record required. Ability to travel with overnight stays required as needed. Some evening, weekend and holiday work may be required. May be required to float to other sites. Guidelines regarding travel time and project vehicle use will be clarified based on specific site needs. This position will maintain background clearance as required by the employer and any collaborating agencies.
Bachelor's Degree in related discipline. Additional related experience may substitute for required education, to the extent permitted by the [Company name masked] equivalency formula.
Applicants who do not meet the posted requirements but are completing their final academic semester/quarter will be considered eligible for employment and may be asked to provide additional information confirming their academic completion date.
The successful candidate(s) for this position will be subject to a pre-employment background check. [Company name masked] is committed to hiring individuals with a justice-involved background, consistent with applicable policies and current practice. A prior criminal history does not automatically preclude candidates from employment. In accordance with applicable law, the university will review, on an individual basis, the date of a candidate's conviction, the nature of the conviction and how the conviction relates to an essential job-related qualification or function.
The pre-employment physical for positions in clinical areas, laboratories, working with research subjects, or involving community contact requires documentation of immune status against Rubella (German measles), Rubeola (Measles), Mumps, Varicella (chickenpox), Hepatitis B and documentation of having received the Tdap (Tetanus, diphtheria, pertussis) vaccination. This may include documentation of having two (2) MMR vaccines; two (2) Varicella vaccines; or antibody status to these diseases from laboratory testing. Blood tests for immunities to these diseases are ordinarily included in the pre-employment physical exam except for those employees who provide results of blood tests or immunization documentation from their own health care providers. Any vaccinations required for these diseases will be given at no cost in our Occupational Health office.

cond_0513.intro:
We are looking for a Research Assistant to join our team. This work is focused on participant recruitment, retention, data collection, and cross-site communication to improve health outcomes in Native communities.
The Research Assistant will work alongside investigators, collaborators, and participants in a research environment, helping to carry out research in accordance with good clinical practices. This includes supporting informed consent processes, data and specimen collection, and participant follow-up over time.
cond_0513.responsibilities:
Maintain a shared working knowledge of all assigned protocols and reporting requirements.
Run routine and ad hoc reports from databases.
Adhere to all protocol requirements to help ensure validity of clinical research data.
Coordinate with clinicians and other stakeholders to access the participant population.
Support recruitment of research participants.
Help verify participant eligibility for studies.
Interview participants.
Schedule follow-up visits.
Assist with data collection.
Enter data into a computer database.
Summarize and share data reports with PIs and Study Physicians.
Maintain paper and computerized research files.
Help facilitate site staff meetings.
Prepare for and participate in audits and monitoring of studies, working alongside the research team.
Assist in preparation of IRB protocols and related documents.
Meet regularly with research staff and site manager to review data accuracy, enrollment reports, and overall study progress.
Share study findings and updates with tribal leaders and community stakeholders.
This description is a general statement of required duties and responsibilities performed on a regular and continuous basis; the Research Assistant will perform other related duties as assigned.
